name: Gustavo Mora
headline: CEO - Principal Consultant
about:
I have over 30+ years of international experience in business consulting, sales management, marketing, and project management. I possess the ability to solve complex problems across organizational and cultural boundaries. Some of my skills include strategic account and project management, solution selling, expertise in industries such as manufacturing, wholesale, distribution, media, and services, managing business relationships, developing multi-company sales strategies, teamwork, and ensuring consulting teams achieve goals and maximize efficiency. I have business analyst expertise, contribute knowledge of the industry, system, and business procedures, provide customer service, establish and maintain good relationships with stakeholders/customers, and evaluate business opportunities related to assigned accounts.

I have worked as a consultant, consulting manager, services director, and founder of consulting firms such as Dominio Consultores, ERP Solutions, Grupo Henshin, and Ti Americas. I have also sold and implemented ERP systems such as JDEdwards, SAP, Epicor, Netsuite, and Odoo. I have worked in consulting services in Mexico, Latin America, USA, and Europe.

In the last 15 years, I have implemented Netsuite and Odoo in Latin America in multiple verticals such as manufacturing, commerce, and services. I have implemented modules such as GA, sales and distribution, purchasing and procurement, advanced inventory manufacturing, WIP, projects, demand planning, forecasting, CRM, and more.
